Chapter 1038: 4: The Terrifying Fierce Sun Divine Body (Requesting Monthly Votes) _2

Chapter 1038: Chapter 4: The Terrifying Fierce Sun Divine Body (Requesting Monthly Votes) _2

“Causing upheaval in Qingfen City is merely a tactic.” “The ultimate goal is to use the Myriad Formation Crystal to duplicate Qingfen City’s formation.”

The woman with purple hair spoke.

Only by preemptively decrypting Qingfen City’s formation, waiting for Purple Dream Domain and other major domains to launch a full-scale attack on Qingfen City, can victory be swift and decisive.”

If not, with Qingfen City’s formation operating at full capacity, coupled with the presence of the city’s core formation, it would be more than sufficient to resist attacks from seven or eight, even up to a dozen peak-level Great Lords of similar rank.”

The core of the plan is the Myriad Formation Crystal.

Such a treasure was granted from the capital, theoretically capable of replicating all formations in existence, and is extremely valuable. Marquis Purple Dream must return it after using it.”

Once Qingfen City’s formation is duplicated successfully, Marquis Purple Dream will immediately invite Ancient Country Formation Masters to crack it, then swiftly ally with other domains to wage war.

Even if Lord Qingfen realizes something is amiss, it will be too late to react. To change Qingfen City’s Grand Array? That cannot be achieved in a short period of time.”

However, they could only execute such a maneuver once.

After breaching Qingfen City, Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s experts would undoubtedly review the incident, easily determining the source of the issue.

At that time, measures would certainly be taken to prevent this from happening again.” “No problem.”

The few figures behind the purple-haired woman nodded slightly.

This mission posed little danger; Lord Qingfen had been drawn away by Marquis Purple Dream, essentially eliminating the greatest threat.”

As for Lord Qingfen’s disciples? Although Lord Qingfen is formidable, he’s notoriously neglectful in his disciple’s training, resulting in mediocre abilities among his students.”

Far inferior to them.”

Even Lord Qingfen’s eldest disciple, Feng Wanxing, pales in strength compared to the purple-haired woman.”

The purple-haired woman’s strength had already half-stepped into the realm of the Great Lord. Among the numerous Sovereign-level figures in Purple Dream Domain, at least ten possess strength comparable to Feng Wanxing.” “I heard that not long ago, Lord Qingfen took in a new disciple. To accept this disciple, he personally left Qingfen City.”

The hunched elderly woman spoke.

This matter wasn’t a secret. After accepting Lin Yuan, Lord Qingfen introduced him to his other disciples, a widely spread and celebrated story within Qingfen Domain—a demonstration of a meteoric rise.”

Initially, the Yu Family was merely a second-tier household, but it soared to become one of the most influential families in Qingfen Domain.” “I’ve heard that too. Given Lord Qingfen’s personality, it’s unlikely he would recklessly leave Qingfen City just for a disciple…”

The man beside her expressed some curiosity.”

Fierce Sun Ancient Country designs its marquis system specifically to defend their respective domains,” and the core of any domain is its Domain City—the Domain City of Qingfen Domain being Qingfen City.”

For Lord Qingfen to leave Qingfen City recklessly entails a certain level of risk.”

If, during that time, an enemy domain launched an assault, Qingfen City would be vulnerable without the suppression of a peak-level Great Lord.”

Though, this scenario is unlikely.”

Lord Qingfen departed without notifying anyone beforehand; enemy domains wouldn’t know and would likely assume he remained within the city. Consequently, such attacks were improbable.”

Moreover, if Lord Qingfen dared leave, he must have confidence in his ability to return instantaneously.”

Thus, the risks were minimized.”

This particular scheme relied on Marquis Purple Dream stalling Lord Qingfen—the act of stalling itself being crucial.”

Only by keeping Lord Qingfen occupied would they have enough time to employ the Myriad Formation Crystal to replicate Qingfen City’s formation.” “Lord Qingfen is cold-hearted. Under orders from Fierce Sun Ancient Country, he accepted several disciples, but none of them dare call him ‘master.'” “Yet for this newly accepted young disciple, he not only risked leaving Qingfen City but spared no expense in his training…”

The purple-haired woman slightly shook her head, “This disciple named ‘Yu Yan’ must possess terrifying talent and aptitude, at least far exceeding Feng Wanxing during his prime.” “Indeed.”

The others nodded slightly, agreeing inwardly.”

If it were an ordinary disciple, Lord Qingfen would never go to such lengths.” “In the future, this individual would undoubtedly become a major calamity for Purple Dream Domain.”

The purple-haired woman offered her assessment, followed by a shake of her head, “However, there will be no future.”

The moment these words were spoken, the others laughed immediately.”

Indeed.

There will be no future.

If this plan succeeds, Qingfen Domain will fall entirely. Even if Lord Qingfen survives, he’ll be reduced to being a fugitive, hiding somewhere to lick his wounds.”

As for the disciples he poured his heart into cultivating?”

There’s hardly a need to worry.”

No matter how heaven-defying the talent may be, without the luxury of time to grow, not even royal progeny of the Ancient Countries poses a threat.”

Even if Yu Yan managed to mature eventually, it would take countless eons.”

At least in Purple Dream Domain’s current scheme, he wouldn’t have any role to play.” “If the duplication of Qingfen City’s formation completes smoothly, the capital will send down a precious treasure.”

The purple-haired woman concluded.”

Her words aimed to boost morale.”

An item deemed a ‘precious treasure’ by the Ancient Country would be coveted even by Great Lord-level experts.”

As for their group of Sovereign-level figures, once obtained, even if they couldn’t use it themselves, they could trade it with a Great Lord, exchanging it for resources they desired.”

Given that it was bestowed by the capital, none would dare attempt to seize it.”

For these Sovereign-level figures, it was reassuring.” “A precious treasure?”

The hunched elderly woman and the others exchanged glances, their eyes gleaming heatedly.”

As it stood, their mission didn’t seem hard to complete,” with the sole potential risk being whether Lord Qingfen would return early.”

Still, under the incentive of the capital’s precious treasure, with no apparent danger or risk, they instead felt slightly uneasy internally.” …

Qingfen City.

Lord Qingfen gazed distantly.”

In recent days, he had clearly sensed abnormal movements from Purple Dream Domain.”

However, given Qingfen Domain’s antagonistic relationship with Purple Dream Domain, such activity was ordinary.” “What exactly does Purple Dream intend to do?”
